Three years

A letter for you 💌

To my Ammu, my Ammukuttaa…

Six days ago, on August 20, we completed 3 beautiful years together. And today, August 26, I get to celebrate the birthday of the person who means more to me than I could ever put into words.

I honestly don't know how to explain how much I love you. Sometimes I feel like even a thousand words wouldn't be enough to express everything I feel for you.

I've never smoked. I've never drunk. But there's one thing I'm completely addicted to…

You. ❤️

Your smile, your voice, your presence, your love — somehow, you became my favourite part of my life without me even realizing how deeply I'd fallen for you.

I don't know what the future has waiting for us, but if I get to choose, I want to keep making memories with you.

I love you more than I know how to express, Ammukuttaa. Thank you for these three years, for every laugh, every silly moment, every conversation, and every memory. We completed three years just six days ago, and somehow I already can't wait for all the memories still waiting for us.

Happy 20th Birthday, my love. 🎂❤️
